data.name: GFM_001
data.value: The trees are closing in...[pause=15] It feels like they're watching us.

data.name: GFM_002
data.value: (The wind just stopped dead.[pause=15] Even the leaves are holding their breath.)

data.name: GFM_003
data.value: The heart of the forest is close.[pause=15] Chenipent can't be far now![pause=0] Let's keep going!

data.name: GFM_004
data.value: The heart has guardians.[pause=20] Prove your steps deserve the clearing.

data.name: GFM_005
data.value: A Shiftry! It's blocking the way to the heart!

data.name: GFM_006
data.value: And a Murkrow![pause=15] They're standing guard together!

data.name: GFM_007
data.value: None approach the heart without the forest's consent.

data.name: GFM_008
data.value: The old master dislikes being disturbed.[pause=15] Turn back.

data.name: GFM_009
data.value: We have a friend to find in the heart of this forest![pause=15] [hero],[pause=10] let's go!

data.name: GFM_010
data.value: The guardians again...[pause=15] This time we end it![pause=0] Let's go!

data.name: GFM_011
data.value: So be it.[pause=20] The forest has heard your answer.

data.name: GFM_012
data.value: The old master will judge you himself.[pause=15] Go on,[pause=10] then.

data.name: GFM_013
data.value: The way is open...[pause=15] The heart of the forest is just ahead!

data.name: GFM_014
data.value: (They didn't hate us.[pause=15] They were protecting something.)

data.name: GFM_015
data.value: Return when the forest has whispered you your place.

data.name: GFM_016
data.value: The heart refuses the weak.[pause=20] Grow,[pause=10] then return.
